rationale: Builds on the current best recurrent-tail/export setup but reallocates the fp16 keep budget away from one of the tail query paths and toward tail value paths, while preserving a final-block query rescue. That is a compact structural/export-budget edit aimed directly at the exact int8+zlib roundtrip score, without changing training loop shape stability, wallclock behavior, or validation flow.
title: Recurrent Tail KV Float Reallocation
